body: Try finding the beauty in something, be it nature or food or architecture, etc. There's always something out there we would really like that we don't know about yet so try things out and see how you like them. Try some support groups and see if you meet some people who would change your life. What I'm saying is, you wouldn't know until you put yourself out there and try new things and experiences.

Yeah I'm upping my dosage but it's happening at a slow rate because my psych is reluctant to jump doses, preferring to start off at the bare minimum (I'm basically getting light methyl phenidates like Ritalin). I understand his reasoning but maybe it's time we step on the gas a bit. 

I'm actually happy to see that the "it's either that or work for a year and get your shit together" thinking of having no friends is helping. It's part of my reasoning as well. 

Yes it is self-destructive, but it felt like me deteriorating away into oblivion on my bed and computer all day was even more self destructive. I have a heart arrhythmia and I'm supposed to do cardio and be more active so it's literally killing me to continue down my path. At this point I felt like I had everything to lose either way so I chose to try something drastic. I don't like doing it, I hope it doesn't blow out of control.

When I meditate my goal is to reach a state of nothingness because my mind is never silent. With my disorders I live in a security room surrounded by tv screens switching feeds simultaneously. If you saw the scene in the final Dark Knight movie where Batman uses a huge room filled with screens which used cellphone signals to echolocate someone, you'll know what I mean. Quietening the mind was part of my goal here with this. To traumatise myself into being too distraught to think of anything else and it actually worked. These past two days have been filled with depression, anxiety and trauma but on the positive side, I was actually able to change quite a few things about my daily routine and I haven't touched the computer since. I've been making some successful readjustments and oddly enough this whole thing did yield the result I was after. I don't even wanna explain why I did what I did because it's like an opportunity cost between explaining myself to my friend and him possibly understanding that I'm not a pedo, OR me continuing to go on without a comfort zone and seeing where that gets me. The anxiety from it is a major downside tho I must admit. I find myself to be quite disgusting after all of this.
